title: Scaffold-ETH Remix.Run
tagline: A scaffold-eth inspired Remix.Run React + Hardhat starter kit
description: This project was inspired by our early days in web3 learning using a development toolkit known as scaffold-eth. Through our experience being dapps and protocols we've worked into a series of app architecture patterns that result in easy to read and maintainable dapps. We wanted to contribute back to the scaffold-eth community and build a fork using our frontend React framework of choice, Remix.Run.
how_its_made: This project was built using Remix.Run (https://remix.run/), an opinionated React framework that strives for using the underlying web fundamentals and Hardhat, the standard contract writing toolkit. In the vein of scaffold-eth, it focuses on a fast developer build and review process, with a shared app Context to facilitate information sharing and updating throughout the app, as well as nice ABI-linking from the Hardhat compile/deploy output.
